meta.title: Dilemma
meta.description: Behind, no retreat is possible. Ahead, the abyss awaits us.

units.rawText: Clang!
units.displayText: Clang!

spans.text: Clang!

units.rawText: Arrows bounce off Eucharist's shield in rapid succession, and their enormous force drives Eucharist back again and again. Even that seemingly-indestructible shield is starting to develop cracks.
units.displayText: Arrows bounce off Eucharist's shield in rapid succession, and their enormous force drives Eucharist back again and again. Even that seemingly-indestructible shield is starting to develop cracks.

units.rawText: You're even so vicious against me! Tch, this eating utensil over here's almost shot through!

units.rawText: Angelus looses three arrows at once and they home in on Eucharist from different directions. There are so many operands gathered on their tips that it distorts the very air.

units.rawText: Eucharist's silver shield suddenly expands, but she's just a moment too slow. The last arrow pierces the shield and throws up a massive shockwave of displaced air that obscures all sight. Even the defunct machinery around them is nearly disintegrated by it.

units.displayText: I'm fine. Let's go now!

units.rawText: Are you hurt?
units.displayText: Are you hurt?

units.displayText: I'm fine.

spans.text: I'm fine.

units.rawText: I didn't think Eucharist would help us...
units.displayText: I didn't think Eucharist would help us...

options.rawText: Looks like working with Sanctifiers in the future isn't necessarily impossible.

units.rawText: Still, this isn't the time to talk about such things — We're here.

units.rawText: ...This is...the "operand black hole"...
units.displayText: ...This is...the "operand black hole"...

spans.text: ...This is...the "operand black hole"...

units.rawText: It is a fathomless black maelstrom that looks like it's going to swallow up everything. The scenery around the hole is distorted, and just looking at it fills one with a formless dread.
units.displayText: It is a fathomless black maelstrom that looks like it's going to swallow up everything. The scenery around the hole is distorted, and just looking at it fills one with a formless dread.

spans.text: It is a fathomless black maelstrom that looks like it's going to swallow up everything. The scenery around the hole is distorted, and just looking at it fills one with a formless dread.

units.rawText: Not far from the hole, an agent who looks like a middle-aged man is weaving through a pile of machines, feverishly performing some kind of operation. A pained look crosses his face every now and then, but his hands do not stop working.
units.displayText: Not far from the hole, an agent who looks like a middle-aged man is weaving through a pile of machines, feverishly performing some kind of operation. A pained look crosses his face every now and then, but his hands do not stop working.

spans.text: Not far from the hole, an agent who looks like a middle-aged man is weaving through a pile of machines, feverishly performing some kind of operation. A pained look crosses his face every now and then, but his hands do not stop working.

units.rawText: ...There's a transmitter over there. The distress signal was probably sent from here.

(Approach and seize the agent.)
(Speak with the agent.)

units.rawText: Careful. We can't be certain of his identity.
units.displayText: Careful. We can't be certain of his identity.

spans.text: Careful. We can't be certain of his identity.

units.rawText: Persicaria nods. We quietly approach the agent and when the time is right, I press a weapon against his waist.
units.displayText: Persicaria nods. We quietly approach the agent and when the time is right, I press a weapon against his waist.

spans.text: Persicaria nods. We quietly approach the agent and when the time is right, I press a weapon against his waist.

units.rawText: Don't look back.
units.displayText: Don't look back.

spans.text: Don't look back.

units.rawText: There's no need to be so wary of an agent with no combat modules.
units.displayText: There's no need to be so wary of an agent with no combat modules.

spans.text: There's no need to be so wary of an agent with no combat modules.

units.rawText: There's two of you. Are you Sanctifiers, or... No, I've never heard your voices before. I don't think you're Residents of the Enigma Sector.
units.displayText: There's two of you. Are you Sanctifiers, or... No, I've never heard your voices before. I don't think you're Residents of the Enigma Sector.

spans.text: There's two of you. Are you Sanctifiers, or... No, I've never heard your voices before. I don't think you're Residents of the Enigma Sector.

units.rawText: You're very sharp. Looks like we were right to be on our guard.
units.displayText: You're very sharp. Looks like we were right to be on our guard.

spans.text: You're very sharp. Looks like we were right to be on our guard.

units.rawText: If you came from outside Enigma, then was it because you received the distress signal...!
units.displayText: If you came from outside Enigma, then was it because you received the distress signal...!

spans.text: If you came from outside Enigma, then was it because you received the distress signal...!

units.displayText: The agent's tone grows excited for a moment, but then he quickly cools down.

spans.text: The agent's tone grows excited for a moment, but then he quickly cools down.

units.rawText: You...
units.displayText: You...

spans.text: You...

units.rawText: Before I can speak, the agent has already gone on the defensive.
units.displayText: Before I can speak, the agent has already gone on the defensive.

spans.text: Before I can speak, the agent has already gone on the defensive.

units.rawText: You... probably aren't agents from Enigma.
units.displayText: You... probably aren't agents from Enigma.

spans.text: You... probably aren't agents from Enigma.

units.rawText: Calm down. We aren't hostile. We only came because we received a distress signal.
units.displayText: Calm down. We aren't hostile. We only came because we received a distress signal.

spans.text: Calm down. We aren't hostile. We only came because we received a distress signal.

units.rawText: The agent freezes up for a moment, then he seems to sigh in relief before quickly approaching us.
units.displayText: The agent freezes up for a moment, then he seems to sigh in relief before quickly approaching us.

spans.text: The agent freezes up for a moment, then he seems to sigh in relief before quickly approaching us.

units.rawText: Thank goodness, please, you have to help me...
units.displayText: Thank goodness, please, you have to help me...

spans.text: Thank goodness, please, you have to help me...

units.rawText: I'm sorry, but we need to know more about the situation first.
units.displayText: I'm sorry, but we need to know more about the situation first.

spans.text: I'm sorry, but we need to know more about the situation first.

units.rawText: Alright, alright... Sorry, I got too worked up.
units.displayText: Alright, alright... Sorry, I got too worked up.

spans.text: Alright, alright... Sorry, I got too worked up.

units.rawText: Allow me to introduce myself. I am Enigma Sector's administrator, Neumann.
units.displayText: Allow me to introduce myself. I am Enigma Sector's administrator, Neumann.

spans.text: Allow me to introduce myself. I am Enigma Sector's administrator, Neumann.

options.rawText: Were you the one who sent the distress signal to the outside world?
options.displayText: Were you the one who sent the distress signal to the outside world?

spans.text: Were you the one who sent the distress signal to the outside world?

options.rawText: How did this "operand black hole" come about?
options.displayText: How did this "operand black hole" come about?

spans.text: How did this "operand black hole" come about?
How should we help you?

units.rawText: Indeed. This quantum computer's gone berserk, and all I can do now is try to forcibly suppress it with operands. But it's sucking in more and more operands, and it could slip out of control at any time.
units.displayText: Indeed. This quantum computer's gone berserk, and all I can do now is try to forcibly suppress it with operands. But it's sucking in more and more operands, and it could slip out of control at any time.

spans.text: Indeed. This quantum computer's gone berserk, and all I can do now is try to forcibly suppress it with operands. But it's sucking in more and more operands, and it could slip out of control at any time.

units.rawText: When that happens, all of Magrasea could be affected.
units.displayText: When that happens, all of Magrasea could be affected.

spans.text: When that happens, all of Magrasea could be affected.

units.rawText: The effects could reach that far? But we calculated...
units.displayText: The effects could reach that far? But we calculated...

spans.text: The effects could reach that far? But we calculated...

units.rawText: That was because the situation is still under control. Once she slips loose, her influence will climb by orders of magnitude.
units.displayText: That was because the situation is still under control. Once she slips loose, her influence will climb by orders of magnitude.

spans.text: That was because the situation is still under control. Once she slips loose, her influence will climb by orders of magnitude.

units.rawText: I've computed the possibilities countless times, but they all show the same thing; I can't stop ENIAC alone...
units.displayText: I've computed the possibilities countless times, but they all show the same thing; I can't stop ENIAC alone...

spans.text: I've computed the possibilities countless times, but they all show the same thing; I can't stop ENIAC alone...

units.rawText: ...I can't stop the quantum computer from going berserk.
units.displayText: ...I can't stop the quantum computer from going berserk.

spans.text: ...I can't stop the quantum computer from going berserk.

units.rawText: So you sent a distress signal to the outside world.
units.displayText: So you sent a distress signal to the outside world.

spans.text: So you sent a distress signal to the outside world.

units.rawText: Yes. I thought there wouldn't be a response... I am so glad to meet you.
units.displayText: Yes. I thought there wouldn't be a response... I am so glad to meet you.

spans.text: Yes. I thought there wouldn't be a response... I am so glad to meet you.

units.rawText: An "operand black hole"... You couldn't have picked a more accurate way to describe it. I never expected ENIAC to end up like this either.
units.displayText: An "operand black hole"... You couldn't have picked a more accurate way to describe it. I never expected ENIAC to end up like this either.

spans.text: An "operand black hole"... You couldn't have picked a more accurate way to describe it. I never expected ENIAC to end up like this either.

units.rawText: ENIAC... Is that the name of this berserk quantum database?
units.displayText: ENIAC... Is that the name of this berserk quantum database?

spans.text: ENIAC... Is that the name of this berserk quantum database?

units.rawText: ENIAC is an agent connected to the quantum database. To say she is the quantum database itself would not be wrong.
units.displayText: ENIAC is an agent connected to the quantum database. To say she is the quantum database itself would not be wrong.

spans.text: ENIAC is an agent connected to the quantum database. To say she is the quantum database itself would not be wrong.

units.rawText: At first, her neural network model was very simple. All she could do was basic sorting work.
units.displayText: At first, her neural network model was very simple. All she could do was basic sorting work.

spans.text: At first, her neural network model was very simple. All she could do was basic sorting work.

units.rawText: As for me and the agents of this sector, all we did was research ways for ENIAC to better store and compute data.
units.displayText: As for me and the agents of this sector, all we did was research ways for ENIAC to better store and compute data.

spans.text: As for me and the agents of this sector, all we did was research ways for ENIAC to better store and compute data.

units.rawText: We reported our research results to the humans, and the humans would apply it to ENIAC, occasionally resetting her mind—
units.displayText: We reported our research results to the humans, and the humans would apply it to ENIAC, occasionally resetting her mind—

spans.text: We reported our research results to the humans, and the humans would apply it to ENIAC, occasionally resetting her mind—

units.rawText: Until one day, when we no longer received any transmissions from the humans.
units.displayText: Until one day, when we no longer received any transmissions from the humans.

spans.text: Until one day, when we no longer received any transmissions from the humans.

units.rawText: ...So this was caused by the disconnection between the cloud server and reality as well...
units.displayText: ...So this was caused by the disconnection between the cloud server and reality as well...

spans.text: ...So this was caused by the disconnection between the cloud server and reality as well...

units.rawText: Ever since, ENIAC's intelligence began to grow. We were very happy to see her grow and kept providing her with operands...
units.displayText: Ever since, ENIAC's intelligence began to grow. We were very happy to see her grow and kept providing her with operands...

spans.text: Ever since, ENIAC's intelligence began to grow. We were very happy to see her grow and kept providing her with operands...

units.rawText: —But in the end, it led to her going berserk.
units.displayText: —But in the end, it led to her going berserk.

spans.text: —But in the end, it led to her going berserk.

units.rawText: I don't know if ENIAC is conscious right now. I hope you can enter the operand black hole and stop her.
units.displayText: I don't know if ENIAC is conscious right now. I hope you can enter the operand black hole and stop her.

spans.text: I don't know if ENIAC is conscious right now. I hope you can enter the operand black hole and stop her.

units.rawText: How about you? Have you tried entering the operand black hole?
units.displayText: How about you? Have you tried entering the operand black hole?

spans.text: How about you? Have you tried entering the operand black hole?

units.rawText: I did, but...
units.displayText: I did, but...

spans.text: I did, but...

units.rawText: Neumann says no more. Instead, he turns toward the operand black hole. As he moves closer to it, a look of pain crosses his face. He collapses to his knees in front of the operand black hole and struggles to raise his hand.
units.displayText: Neumann says no more. Instead, he turns toward the operand black hole. As he moves closer to it, a look of pain crosses his face. He collapses to his knees in front of the operand black hole and struggles to raise his hand.

units.rawText: —Look out!
units.displayText: —Look out!

spans.text: —Look out!

units.rawText: Just before Neumann's hand enters the black hole, a wave of operands surges out from it and sends him flying back.
units.displayText: Just before Neumann's hand enters the black hole, a wave of operands surges out from it and sends him flying back.

spans.text: Just before Neumann's hand enters the black hole, a wave of operands surges out from it and sends him flying back.

units.rawText: (Groans and coughs heavily)
units.displayText: Groans and coughs heavily

spans.text: Groans and coughs heavily

units.rawText: Persicaria moves up to support Neumann as he coughs uncontrollably and his eyes go dim. The light of healing operands flow toward his body from Persica's palms, and he slowly quiets down.
units.displayText: Persicaria moves up to support Neumann as he coughs uncontrollably and his eyes go dim. The light of healing operands flow toward his body from Persica's palms, and he slowly quiets down.

units.rawText: ...Thank you. I've tried many times, but this is the limit for how close I can get.
units.displayText: ...Thank you. I've tried many times, but this is the limit for how close I can get.

spans.text: ...Thank you. I've tried many times, but this is the limit for how close I can get.

units.rawText: ENIAC is blocking me from entering. Perhaps she is instinctively rejecting me... After all, I was the one who caused an outcome like this.
units.displayText: ENIAC is blocking me from entering. Perhaps she is instinctively rejecting me... After all, I was the one who caused an outcome like this.

spans.text: ENIAC is blocking me from entering. Perhaps she is instinctively rejecting me... After all, I was the one who caused an outcome like this.

units.rawText: ...Your neural cloud is very weak. Don't do that again.
units.displayText: ...Your neural cloud is very weak. Don't do that again.

spans.text: ...Your neural cloud is very weak. Don't do that again.

units.rawText: The closer you get to the black hole, the more it affects your neural cloud — I believe your body knows that better than I do.
units.displayText: The closer you get to the black hole, the more it affects your neural cloud — I believe your body knows that better than I do.

spans.text: The closer you get to the black hole, the more it affects your neural cloud — I believe your body knows that better than I do.

units.rawText: But I can only regulate ENIAC's ever-expanding zone of influence from here...
units.displayText: But I can only regulate ENIAC's ever-expanding zone of influence from here...

spans.text: But I can only regulate ENIAC's ever-expanding zone of influence from here...

units.rawText: ...No, perhaps I just wanted to keep ENIAC company.
units.displayText: ...No, perhaps I just wanted to keep ENIAC company.

spans.text: ...No, perhaps I just wanted to keep ENIAC company.

units.rawText: I need to try everything I can. I can't let her face this alone.
units.displayText: I need to try everything I can. I can't let her face this alone.

spans.text: I need to try everything I can. I can't let her face this alone.

units.rawText: ...Tell us about the situation inside the operand black hole, and what we should do.
units.displayText: ...Tell us about the situation inside the operand black hole, and what we should do.

spans.text: ...Tell us about the situation inside the operand black hole, and what we should do.

units.rawText: Persicaria, you...
units.displayText: Persicaria, you...

spans.text: Persicaria, you...

units.rawText: Neumann already said that ENIAC could go out of control at any time.
units.displayText: Neumann already said that ENIAC could go out of control at any time.

spans.text: Neumann already said that ENIAC could go out of control at any time.

units.rawText: We put so much effort into building the Oasis — we can't let it all be destroyed just like that, right?
units.displayText: We put so much effort into building the Oasis — we can't let it all be destroyed just like that, right?

spans.text: We put so much effort into building the Oasis — we can't let it all be destroyed just like that, right?
You're right.

options.rawText: ...In any case, let's learn more about the situation before making a decision.
options.displayText: ...In any case, let's learn more about the situation before making a decision.

spans.text: ...In any case, let's learn more about the situation before making a decision.

units.rawText: I don't know how to express my gratitude... If you can stop ENIAC, I'll do anything for you!
units.displayText: I don't know how to express my gratitude... If you can stop ENIAC, I'll do anything for you!

spans.text: I don't know how to express my gratitude... If you can stop ENIAC, I'll do anything for you!

units.rawText: Hopefully things will go the way we want.
units.displayText: Hopefully things will go the way we want.

spans.text: Hopefully things will go the way we want.

units.rawText: As for the conditions inside the operand black hole...
units.displayText: As for the conditions inside the operand black hole...

spans.text: As for the conditions inside the operand black hole...

units.rawText: I can't go in there, so I can only tell you the results of my projections.
units.displayText: I can't go in there, so I can only tell you the results of my projections.

spans.text: I can't go in there, so I can only tell you the results of my projections.

units.rawText: ENIAC has a great deal of data within her. All this data has become chaotic, an unregulated data turbulence.
units.displayText: ENIAC has a great deal of data within her. All this data has become chaotic, an unregulated data turbulence.

spans.text: ENIAC has a great deal of data within her. All this data has become chaotic, an unregulated data turbulence.

units.rawText: The neural clouds of agents which enter it will become part of that vast mass of data.
units.displayText: The neural clouds of agents which enter it will become part of that vast mass of data.

spans.text: The neural clouds of agents which enter it will become part of that vast mass of data.

units.rawText: Simply put... Only by preserving your consciousness and your true self can you leave the black hole.
units.displayText: Simply put... Only by preserving your consciousness and your true self can you leave the black hole.

spans.text: Simply put... Only by preserving your consciousness and your true self can you leave the black hole.

units.rawText: Maintaining your neural cloud stability amidst the impact of this massive quantity of data is just too difficult... Do you have any related projection data?
units.displayText: Maintaining your neural cloud stability amidst the impact of this massive quantity of data is just too difficult... Do you have any related projection data?

spans.text: Maintaining your neural cloud stability amidst the impact of this massive quantity of data is just too difficult... Do you have any related projection data?

units.rawText: You know neural clouds very well.
units.displayText: You know neural clouds very well.

spans.text: You know neural clouds very well.

units.rawText: If you want us to help, then you need to start with honesty, right?
units.displayText: If you want us to help, then you need to start with honesty, right?

spans.text: If you want us to help, then you need to start with honesty, right?

units.rawText: ...You are correct.
units.displayText: ...You are correct.

spans.text: ...You are correct.

units.rawText: Neumann turns and works on a machine for a bit, and the virtual monitor displays a shocking number of calculation formulas.
units.displayText: Neumann turns and works on a machine for a bit, and the virtual monitor displays a shocking number of calculation formulas.

spans.text: Neumann turns and works on a machine for a bit, and the virtual monitor displays a shocking number of calculation formulas.

units.rawText: This is all the data and their results. Given the strength of my own neural cloud, I figure the chances of success are... 15% or so.
units.displayText: This is all the data and their results. Given the strength of my own neural cloud, I figure the chances of success are... 15% or so.

spans.text: This is all the data and their results. Given the strength of my own neural cloud, I figure the chances of success are... 15% or so.

units.rawText: Once you're lost in the black hole, you will become part of that data turbulence forever. Unable to die, and unable to be reset.
units.displayText: Once you're lost in the black hole, you will become part of that data turbulence forever. Unable to die, and unable to be reset.

spans.text: Once you're lost in the black hole, you will become part of that data turbulence forever. Unable to die, and unable to be reset.

units.rawText: ...And that's just the first step in stopping ENIAC.
units.displayText: ...And that's just the first step in stopping ENIAC.

units.rawText: We both fall silent.
units.displayText: We both fall silent.

spans.text: We both fall silent.

units.rawText: This is definitely a difficult decision to make, but we have no choice but to face it.
units.displayText: This is definitely a difficult decision to make, but we have no choice but to face it.
